title: Heart and great vessels on chest CT, second set: more scanners, hospitals and heart-gated studies
description: More chest CTs of adults from the TotalSegmentator CT dataset v3.0.0 (several hospitals and three scanner makes, including Philips), cropped from above the aortic arch to below the heart at 3 mm: heart-gated and routine studies, contrast-enhanced and not, with the dataset's own outlines of the heart, aorta, left atrial appendage, pulmonary veins, venae cavae and arch branches, and unreviewed AI outlines of the four chambers, the left ventricular muscle and the pulmonary arteries on the contrast studies.

sources.name: TotalSegmentator CT dataset v3.0.0 (1,939 CT images with 117 segmented structures; University Hospital Basel)
sources.citation: Wasserthal J, Breit HC, Meyer MT, Pradella M, Cyriac J, Yang S, Bach M, Segeroth M. TotalSegmentator: robust segmentation of 104 anatomical structures in CT images. Radiology: Artificial Intelligence. 2023;5(5):e230024. doi:10.1148/ryai.230024. Dataset: Wasserthal J et al., Dataset with segmentations of 117 important anatomical structures in 1939 CT images (version 3.0.0), Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22688904.
sources.accessNote: Totalsegmentator_dataset_v300.zip (37.4 GB, Zenodo record 22688904; licence and file name read from https://zenodo.org/api/records/22688904 on 2026-11-09) read with HTTP range requests: meta.csv, and for each chosen case ct.nii.gz and the segmentation masks named in each target; every member checked against its zip CRC-32.

sources.name: Horalix (horalix.com)
sources.license: AI-generated drafts for this app; the segmentation tool and its licence are listed in docs/data/heart-ct-report.md
sources.citation: Thanks to Horalix.com, the heart chamber and pulmonary artery outlines are marked. The outlines are AI, not reviewed by a radiologist.
sources.accessNote: Unreviewed AI drafts; never used for grading.

referenceTargets.label: Heart

provenanceDetail.method: Segmentation distributed with the TotalSegmentator CT dataset. Its authors describe the labels as made with public segmentation models or an iteratively retrained nnU-Net and then manually reviewed and corrected where necessary, supervised by two radiologists with 3 and 6 years of body-imaging experience (Wasserthal et al. 2023); version 3.0.0 refined many labels. Model-assisted and radiologist-verified, not drawn from scratch; this pack has not reviewed them again. Mask on the CT grid, cut to the chest slices kept here, largest connected part(s) only, traced per slice with skimage find_contours (0.5) into image_px [col, row].
provenanceDetail.note: 50 slices; 1 connected part(s) in the crop; median 143 HU.
